significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish a form-(iii) law—across regulatory cascades, "direct edges will survive representational conditioning on mediators while indirect edges will vanish"—plus the form-(ii) mechanistic claim that this structure "causally govern[s] how the model propagates in-silico perturbations." This would constrain predictions for untested cascades and distinguish whether network-oriented models such as Geneformer (Theodoris et al., Nature, 2023) and scGPT (Cui et al., Nature Methods, 2024) encode direct-versus-mediated regulation rather than merely recover associated genes; it establishes both a representational phenomenon and, if mediation blocking holds, a load-bearing mechanism. True and false are distinguishable, but the negative branch is less decisive than claimed: null conditional selectivity rules out this specific d-separation signature, not every possible distributed mechanistic encoding, so it cannot by itself prove the "co-expression view." Topic substitution lowers the assessment from what the scientific importance of gene regulation alone might suggest, but not below the above-topic baseline because the direct/mediated conditional law and perturbation-path consequence are specific constraints absent from a median representation-probing claim.

reach.justification: The transferable handles are the explicitly named "Conditional-Independence Selectivity Index (CISI)" and "Mediation-Blocking Asymmetry (MBA)," together with the decision rule that a consistently null CISI means users should "treat [scFMs] as co-expression encoders useful for hypothesis screening." CISI can operate ex ante as an audit before a pretrained model is trusted as a mechanistic prior, while MBA is mainly a post-hoc diagnostic of perturbation propagation. After per-model re-extraction, the hypothesis predicts a relation rather than merely supplying a search procedure—conditioned direct association should exceed conditioned indirect association—although its asserted scope is principally single-cell foundation models and relevant cell types, not foundation models or scientific domains generally. Topic substitution would not preserve this score because the generic topic supplies neither the CISI/MBA handles nor the direct-versus-mediated audit; downstream uptake plausibly includes single-cell researchers selecting, auditing, or using models for perturbation-guided discovery.
